answer: Proof of Space-Time counters Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to store a key-salted, non-compressible plot and pass random Merkle audits before tight deadlines. Because every plot has a distinct layout like an opal, clones cannot share bytes to siphon reward nectar across an open agent tundra, forcing attackers to fund dedicated disk capacity and read IOPS per identity. However, operators with cheap bulk storage can still amortize large farms and price out stateless edge agents.
